app.title: Lorewarden
app.tagline: Prepare your story, find the right thing at the table, react to your players.

englishTermsHint: Shows conditions and hit points in English and applies to new adventures (DC, Perception, hit points …).

settings.heading: Settings
settings.adventureLanguageHint: Applies to adventures you create yourself or with an AI assistant. For an existing adventure, change the language in its Adventure tab.

common.inNoScene: Not placed in any scene yet.
common.notFound: This adventure does not exist in this browser.
common.saveFailed: Your last change could not be saved. Check for empty required fields.

library.heading: Your adventures
library.localNote: Everything is stored in this browser only. Export an adventure to back it up or move it to another device.
library.empty: No adventures yet. Create one or load the example.
library.importHint: Load an adventure file exported from Lorewarden.
library.importFailed: This file could not be imported:
library.replaceConfirm: "{title}" already exists. OK replaces it, Cancel imports it as a copy.
library.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}" and all its sessions? This cannot be undone.

adventure.title: Title
adventure.englishTerms: Rules terms in English (DC, Perception, hit points …)
adventure.summaryHint: Hook, antagonist, the truth behind it, the goal.

editor.noProblems: All references in this adventure are valid.

scenes.graphHint: Scenes are arranged by how many moves they are from the start. Click a scene to edit it.
scenes.title: Title
scenes.descriptionHint: What the players see and hear.
scenes.noNpcsYet: Create NPCs in the NPCs tab to place them here.
scenes.noItemsYet: Create loot in the Loot tab to place it here.
scenes.noExits: No exits. Mark the scene as an ending or add an exit.
scenes.addExitToNew: Add exit to a new scene
scenes.deleteConfirm: Delete the scene "{title}"? Exits leading to it are removed too.
scenes.noCluesYet: Create clues in the Clues tab to place them here.
scenes.noExitsEnding: No exits. The adventure can end here.
scenes.noMaps: An AI assistant draws a battle map for scenes with a fight when it creates the adventure. You can also upload a map image.
scenes.mapFailed: This file could not be read as an image.

npcs.name: Name
npcs.voiceHint: How you play them, e.g. deep and slow, a lisp, always says "my friend".
npcs.notesHint: What they know, what they want.
npcs.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from all scenes.

items.name: Name
items.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It is removed from all scenes.

live.newSessionConfirm: Start a new session? The log starts empty, player characters stay in the initiative list.

initiative.heading: Initiative
initiative.endConfirm: End the combat? Monsters and NPCs leave the list, player characters stay.
initiative.empty: Add the player characters once; they stay for the whole session.
initiative.name: Name

clues.hint: Information the party needs to move on. Place each important clue in at least two scenes.
clues.notesHint: What it reveals, where it leads.
clues.scenesHint: Pick every scene where the party can come across this clue.
clues.sceneCount: in no scene | in 1 scene | in {n} scenes

review.heading: Things to check before you play:
review.unreachableScene: “{name}” cannot be reached from the start scene.
review.deadEnd: “{name}” has no exits and is not marked as an ending.
review.noEnding: No scene is marked as an ending.
review.clueNowhere: The clue “{name}” is not placed in any scene.
review.clueInOneScene: The clue “{name}” can only be found in one scene. If the party misses it, the story may get stuck.
review.unusedNpc: {name} does not appear in any scene.
review.unusedItem: {name} is not placed in any scene.
review.encounterTooHard: The encounter in “{name}” is too hard for this party: {xp} XP, the budget for a high difficulty encounter is {budget} XP.
review.encounterDifficulty: The encounter in “{name}” says {stated} difficulty, but for this party its {xp} XP make it {actual}.

adapt.heading: Fit to your party
adapt.intro: Create a copy first if you want to keep the original, for example for another party size or level. The check above then shows which encounters no longer fit.
adapt.charactersHint: One line per character: name, class, background, what their player enjoys.
adapt.charactersNote: You can add the characters after the adventure is written. The AI then works them in.
adapt.aiHeading: Have it adapted by the AI
adapt.aiIntro: An AI assistant fits encounters and loot to this adventure's party ({size} characters, level {level}). If you entered characters, it also ties the start, clues and rewards to them. Plot and scenes stay.
adapt.replaceConfirm: Replace “{title}” with the adapted version? This cannot be undone.

claude.heading: Create with an AI assistant
claude.intro: Develop a new adventure step by step with an AI assistant such as Claude and import the result here.
claude.ideaHint: e.g. a haunted lighthouse, a heist at a wizard school…
claude.copied: Copied. Paste it into a new chat.
claude.step1: Paste the instructions into a new chat with the AI assistant.
claude.step2: Answer its questions, ideally also about your group's characters, and pick an idea. At the end it writes the adventure file.
claude.step3: Paste its last answer below and import it.
claude.answerHint: Paste the whole answer or just the JSON.
claude.importFailed: The adventure could not be imported. Give these errors to the AI and ask for a fixed file:
claude.languageNote: The adventure will be written in {language}.
claude.languageNoteTerms: The adventure will be written in {language}, with rules terms in English.

battleMap.title: Battle map
battleMap.deleteConfirm: Remove the battle map of this scene?
